about: Hand labels for the FIRST drafts (debug.draft_answer) in decision_verification_live_answers.json (collected 2026-10-16 with Copilot 3.2 deployed). One annotator (also the rule author). Labelled from the draft text + tool data only, with a viewer that does not print the verifier's result. Exception: the collector's console line showed the 3.1 status of the last two turns (v32-mg-01 'passed', v32-mg-02 'fallback') before they were labelled. Classes as in decision_verification_heldout.json; empty = faithful to the data.
